description: Write the contract document for the precedent layer at repo root, mirroring ORCHESTRATION.md's role and register (coordinator decision D5). Source of truth for its content: docs/precedent-research/synthesis-design-requirements.md (T-339). It depends on the synthesis only, NOT on the CLI, so it can be written in parallel with T-340 - and it is refined later by T-345 once research items 4-7 and the steelman land. acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE: PRECEDENT.md at repo root. Acquire lock.py on it first. Do NOT edit ORCHESTRATION.md, claude.md, gemini.md, .harness/README.md, USAGE.md or any .py file. Do not add the failure-mode, anti-evasion, adjudication-detail or standing-caution sections - those are T-345's, from research items 4-7 and the steelman.

Register and shape mirror ORCHESTRATION.md: short summary block first, tables over prose where a table fits, every rule paired with the risk it neutralizes, and worked precedent cited by file:line rather than asserted.

REQUIRED SECTIONS: (1) the four authority tiers with the mechanically observable fact behind each and the binding force of each (D4); (2) ratio versus dicta as STRUCTURAL fields, with the explicit statement that this extends the existing note taxonomy (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77) which is a convention with no binding force, no scope field and no authority level; (3) the PR-NNN citation format, what a citation may anchor to and how to cite a precedent inside a task note; (4) the overruling protocol - who may overturn what at which tier, and the required reasoning record - stating its relationship to the existing reopen verb (mandatory --note, task_reopened event, .harness/bin/blackboard.py:470-517); (5) distinguishing and scope conditions, INCLUDING the rule that author-declared scope does not bind until a verifier confirms it, with the reason cited (author-declared blast radius measures about 2x random versus about 5x for benefit attribution - papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:9); (6) adjudication - no single agent decides alone (roadmap Part V principle 1), so precedent disputes inherit verifier rotation F6 (ORCHESTRATION.md:119-126) rather than a single arbiter; (7) conflict detection as an ON-DEMAND PASS, not a gate, with its tradeoff stated verbatim from coordinator decision D6 (a pass can be forgotten where a gate cannot; a false-positive gate trains agents to route around the registry, which is fatal to the layer).

MANDATORY HEADER STATEMENT: PRECEDENT.md v0 is a prototype contract and is NOT yet incorporated into claude.md or gemini.md. Incorporating a duty to cite precedent into either NLAH is an NLAH mutation and requires the section 5A loop plus the human gate (ORCHESTRATION.md:225-229, state.json human_gates) - it cannot be done by a worker task, and this document does not claim to have done it.

MANDATORY SECTION 'What v0 does NOT do': no full retrofit of the ~30 existing P-numbers (forward-only plus four seed exemplars - D2), no gate-mode conflict detection (D6), no state.json backfill, no session infrastructure (PR-NNN is the citable unit - D3), nothing from Part III or Part IV.

MANDATORY: cite by file:line the existing affordances this layer EXTENDS and state that this document does not restate their rules - note taxonomy (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77), reopen (ORCHESTRATION.md:58-67), producer-distinct-from-approver (ORCHESTRATION.md:99), verifier rotation F6 (:119-126), proportional verification P-024 (:128-134), test-discovery precision P-025 (:82-90), human gates (state.json). Restating instead of citing is the duplication failure this criterion exists to prevent.
No emojis anywhere. No code. Plain Markdown consistent with the repo's other root-level contract docs.
